hook: Even during strikes by the United States and Israel, Iran hunted dissidents abroad.

sections.voiceover: Even during strikes by the United States and Israel, Iran hunted dissidents abroad.

Reuters published an October 2026 report detailing coordinated repression. Security forces, judges, and state broadcasters targeted anti-government critics everywhere. Where did the state direct its wartime crackdown?
Iran International reported that mass prosecutions and executions intensified during the wartime crackdown.
Iran International confirmed investigators uncovered international operations. Officials pursued dissidents across borders despite foreign military strikes. BDNews24 published the findings worldwide.
Reuters exposed Iran operating across international borders during the October 2026 crisis.
